misprints.printed: en förmögenhet på 30 talenter, οὐσία δέκα ταλάντων l. δεκατάλαντος
misprints.note: The Swedish number does not match the Greek one.
The circumflex is missing in the print.
No breathing is printed after the bracketed prefix. This may be deliberate, since it is a compound.
The genitive ending is printed with an acute instead of a circumflex.
No rough breathing is printed on the capital Ρ.
Påk: the print has υ, not ο.
No full stop after the abbreviation.
The 'm' is printed broken and looks like 'ın'. I transcribed it as m.

uncertain.note: The iota subscripts are very faint at this resolution. I kept them.
Strip 01 ends with ἰέναι and strip 02 begins with it. The breathing looks smooth both times.
